title: Self-Explore: Enhancing Mathematical Reasoning in Language Models with Fine-grained Rewards
authors_zh: Hyeonbin Hwang、Doyoung Kim、Seungone Kim、Seonghyeon Ye、Minjoon Seo
paper_type_zh: 拒绝采样、首个不可恢复步骤定位与细粒度偏好构造
best_for_zh: 研究如何将失败推理轨迹转化为程序化步骤监督、并审计有限搜索标签的读者
one_line: Self-Explore converts rejected math rationales into prompt/chosen/pit-step preferences by searching for the first prefix with no correct recovery among four samples; code is open, but paper-run generated pairs are not.
Self-Explore 从被拒数学推理中搜索首个四次续写均无法恢复正确答案的步骤，并构造 prompt/chosen/错误步骤偏好对；代码已开放，但论文运行生成的数据对未发布。
why: It shows how answer-verifiable rejected traces can be recycled into step-local supervision while making finite-search labels, selective pair coverage, and unreleased generation ledgers central audit risks.
inclusion_reason: Recycles rejected self-generated math traces into model-relative, first-pit preference supervision and exposes the construction code, while leaving the generated training artifacts and decision ledger unreleased.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Rejection-sampling fine-tuning keeps self-generated solutions that reach the reference answer, while outcome-level preference learning contrasts complete correct and incorrect solutions. Both discard structure inside failed traces. If a rationale follows several useful steps and then makes one mistake, whole-sequence rejection penalizes the correct prefix; it may also penalize coherent downstream reasoning whose only problem is that it inherited an earlier wrong value.

Self-Explore asks whether the same model family can turn those rejected traces into finer supervision without human step labels or a separately trained process reward model. Its operational target is not “the first mathematically false statement” in an absolute sense. It is the first tested step after which the RFT explorer fails to sample any continuation that reaches the gold final answer under a fixed budget.

This distinction defines the data problem. The construction pipeline must preserve the source question and answer, the model-specific candidate rationale, outcome verification, step segmentation, four continuation attempts from each prefix, and the first zero-recovery decision. Without that lineage, a final prompt/chosen/rejected row hides whether the rejected step was truly wrong, merely hard for this checkpoint to recover from, or mislabeled by answer extraction.

The paper studies this recipe on GSM8K and MATH with Mistral-7B, Llemma-7B, and DeepSeek-Math-7B-Base. Its relevance to open data construction is therefore less about a downloadable corpus—the generated corpora are not released—and more about how failed rollouts can be converted into auditable pairwise process supervision.

拒绝采样微调会保留最终到达参考答案的自生成解答，结果级偏好学习则对比完整的正确与错误解答。两者都会浪费失败轨迹内部的结构。如果一条推理先完成若干有效步骤，随后才出现一个错误，整条拒绝会连正确前缀一起惩罚；它还可能压低后续本身连贯、只是继承了早期错误数值的推理。

Self-Explore 研究同一模型家族能否在没有人工步骤标签、也没有单独过程奖励模型的情况下，把这些拒绝轨迹转化为更细粒度监督。其操作目标不是绝对意义上的“第一个数学错误陈述”，而是：在固定搜索预算下，从某个已测试步骤继续生成时，RFT 探索器第一次无法采样到任何到达金标最终答案的续写。

这一差异决定了需要审计的数据对象。构造流水线应保留来源问题与答案、模型专属候选推理、结果验证、步骤切分、从每个前缀出发的四次续写，以及首个零恢复步骤的判定。缺少这些来源链，最终的 prompt/chosen/rejected 行就无法说明被拒步骤究竟真的错误、只是当前检查点难以从中恢复，还是被答案抽取器误标。

论文在 GSM8K 和 MATH 上测试 Mistral-7B、Llemma-7B 与 DeepSeek-Math-7B-Base。它对开放数据构造的价值主要不在于可直接下载的生成语料——这些语料并未发布——而在于展示如何把失败 rollout 转化为可审计的成对过程监督。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Each model first becomes a zero-shot math generator through supervised fine-tuning on the human-curated task solutions. It then samples 100 rationales per training question at temperature 0.7. After heuristic deduplication and task-specific answer checking, correct rationales form the rejection-sampling fine-tuning set; the resulting RFT checkpoint acts both as the preference-training reference model and as the explorer.

Outcome-level pairs match one verified-correct rationale with one verified-incorrect rationale from the same question. The pairing code favors dissimilar negatives and uses each selected solution once. Conventional DPO would compare the two complete responses. Self-Explore instead splits the rejected rationale into steps and asks the RFT model to continue from successive prefixes, sampling four completions at temperature 0.7 at each tested step.

If at least one continuation reaches the ground-truth answer, the current prefix remains recoverable under the search. The first step with zero correct continuations is labeled the first pit. If every tested prefix admits a successful continuation, the alleged negative is discarded because it is not infeasible from the explorer's perspective. The granular row then moves the pre-pit prefix into the prompt, uses the pit step as the rejected completion, and uses a correct continuation sampled from the preceding prefix as chosen.

The construction thus changes what DPO compares. It increases the likelihood of a full recovery completion while decreasing only the localized pit step, preserving correct context before the failure and avoiding direct penalties on everything after it. The label is useful because it is actionable for the target model, but it is model- and budget-relative rather than a semantic proof of error.

每个模型先在人工整理的任务解答上做监督微调，获得零样本数学解题能力；随后以温度 0.7 为每个训练问题采样 100 条推理。经过启发式去重和任务专属答案检查后，正确推理构成拒绝采样微调数据；所得 RFT 检查点既是偏好训练的参考模型，也是后续探索器。

结果级偏好对会在同一问题下匹配一条验证正确的推理和一条验证错误的推理。配对代码倾向选择差异较大的负例，并让每个被选解答只使用一次。传统 DPO 会比较两条完整响应；Self-Explore 则把被拒推理切分成步骤，从连续前缀出发让 RFT 模型继续生成，在每个测试步骤以温度 0.7 采样四条续写。

只要至少一条续写到达金标答案，当前前缀就在该搜索预算下仍可恢复。第一次出现四条续写全错的步骤被标记为 first pit。如果所有测试前缀都能产生成功续写，这个所谓负例会被丢弃，因为从探索器视角看它并非不可行。随后，细粒度偏好行把 pit 之前的前缀移入 prompt，把 pit 步骤作为 rejected，并把从前一前缀采样到的正确续写作为 chosen。

因此，这套构造改变了 DPO 的比较对象：它提高完整恢复续写的概率，只降低被定位 pit 步骤的概率，从而保留失败前的正确上下文，也避免直接惩罚错误之后的全部内容。该标签之所以有用，是因为它对目标模型具有可操作性；但它相对于模型与预算定义，并不是错误的语义证明。

title: Method
方法
html:
The source repository contains GSM8K_train/test.jsonl and MATH_train/test.jsonl; the paper uses 7,473/1,319 GSM8K train/test problems and 7,500/5,000 MATH train/test problems. The main runs are separate for Mistral-7B, Llemma-7B, and DeepSeek-Math-7B-Base. There is no external rationale teacher: each SFT model generates its own candidate corpus, and the corresponding RFT model explores its own model family's rejected traces.

Raw generation uses vLLM with 100 outputs per problem, temperature 0.7, top-p 1, and maximum lengths of 512 tokens for GSM8K and 1,024 for MATH. The released GSM8K code deduplicates exact strings, extracts final answers, verifies equations enclosed by double angle brackets with Python evaluation and tolerance 1e-3, groups by equation signatures, and keeps up to eight diverse correct responses. The MATH code requires a recognizable final-answer marker, uses task-specific equivalence evaluation, shuffles with seed 42, applies normalized edit-distance deduplication, and keeps up to eight correct and 24 incorrect candidates.

Outcome-pair construction differs slightly by task. GSM8K pairs each retained correct solution with the remaining incorrect solution of maximum raw edit distance, then removes that negative from the pool. MATH searches for negatives above descending normalized edit-distance thresholds and chooses the shortest eligible one, falling back to the shortest candidate; it also removes used negatives. The paper describes a general maximum-edit-distance design and an eight-pair cap, but Appendix Table 5 marks Mistral/GSM8K as an uncapped exception.

For exploration, rejected responses are segmented into line-based steps for GSM8K and heuristic merged steps for MATH. The code tests at most 20 steps. At each prefix it samples four completions and records the prompt, generated continuations, and extracted answers. The first prefix with zero correct continuations supplies the pit. If the pit is the first step, the original question is the prompt and the original correct response is chosen. Otherwise, the prompt ends immediately before the pit and a successful continuation from that prefix is chosen.

There is a paper-code discrepancy in chosen selection. The paper says it randomly selects one correct completion from the prefix before the pit; current form_gpair code sorts eligible recoveries by length and takes the shortest unused one after overlap checks. The code also deduplicates chosen and rejected spans across pairs. Before DPO, prepare_dataset.py strips a rejected conclusion containing “The answer is,” matching Appendix C's report that retaining conflicting conclusion statements degraded training.

Training proceeds through SFT, RFT, and preference optimization. The paper reports two epochs for the base generator, one epoch for RFT, and three DPO epochs, while checkpoint comparisons span five SFT/RFT epochs. Released DPO configuration uses beta 0.1, seed 42, RMSprop, linear scheduling, and a 100-row evaluation subset copied from training; optimization-time evaluation is therefore not held out.

来源仓库包含 GSM8K_train/test.jsonl 与 MATH_train/test.jsonl。论文使用 GSM8K 的 7473/1319 个训练/测试问题，以及 MATH 的 7500/5000 个训练/测试问题。主实验分别针对 Mistral-7B、Llemma-7B 和 DeepSeek-Math-7B-Base 运行，没有外部推理教师：每个 SFT 模型生成自己的候选语料，相应的 RFT 模型再探索同一模型家族的拒绝轨迹。

原始生成通过 vLLM 完成：每题 100 个输出，温度 0.7，top-p 为 1；GSM8K 最大 512 token，MATH 最大 1024 token。公开的 GSM8K 代码先做字符串去重与最终答案抽取，再用 Python 求值和 1e-3 容差检查双尖括号包围的每个算式，按算式签名分组，并最多保留八条多样化正确响应。MATH 代码要求可识别的最终答案标记，使用任务专属等价判断，以种子 42 打乱，通过归一化编辑距离去重，最多保留八条正确候选和 24 条错误候选。

两项任务的结果级配对略有不同。GSM8K 为每条保留的正确解答选择原始编辑距离最大的剩余错误解答，并从候选池移除该负例。MATH 按递减的归一化编辑距离阈值搜索负例，在满足阈值者中选择最短的一条；如果均不满足则退回最短候选，同样不重复使用负例。论文将其概括为最大编辑距离设计和每题八对上限，但附录表 5 把 Mistral/GSM8K 标记为未应用上限的例外。

探索阶段把 GSM8K 拒绝响应按行切步，把 MATH 响应用启发式规则合并成步骤；代码最多测试 20 步。每个前缀采样四条续写，并记录 prompt、生成续写和抽取答案。第一个四次续写均不正确的前缀产生 pit。如果 pit 就是第一步，prompt 只含原问题，chosen 使用原始正确响应；否则 prompt 截止到 pit 之前，并从该前缀的成功续写中选 chosen。

论文与代码在 chosen 选择上存在差异。论文称从 pit 前一前缀的正确续写中随机选一条；当前 form_gpair 代码则在排除重叠与重复后按长度排序，选择最短的未用续写。代码还跨偏好对去重 chosen 和 rejected。DPO 前，prepare_dataset.py 会删除 rejected 中含“The answer is”的结论，这与附录 C 的观察一致：同时保留冲突结论会导致训练退化。

训练依次进行 SFT、RFT 和偏好优化。论文报告基础生成器训练两轮、RFT 训练一轮、DPO 训练三轮，但 SFT/RFT 的比较检查点覆盖五轮。公开 DPO 配置使用 beta 0.1、随机种子 42、RMSprop 和线性调度；训练过程中的 eval 是从训练数据复制出的 100 行子集，因此并非独立留出评测。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official ACL paper evaluates SFT, RFT, outcome-supervised DPO, and Self-Explore across all three 7B families on GSM8K and MATH. It reports average improvements over SFT of 11.57% on GSM8K and 2.89% on MATH, with gains for every model family. These are downstream accuracy results under the authors' training and checkpoint-selection protocol; they support the usefulness of the generated supervision but do not validate every first-pit label.

DeepSeek-Math ablations isolate the span design. Table 1 reports 74.83/34.92 accuracy for whole pairwise data and 78.47/37.68 for granular pairwise data on GSM8K/MATH. Using only the first chosen step or rejecting the pit plus all later steps performs between those conditions, supporting the specific choice to retain a full recovery completion while rejecting only the pit. A separate ablation varies exploration width from four to 32 and finds no improvement from more samples, showing that the operational label's usefulness does not monotonically track a larger search budget.

Appendix Table 5 reports the actual training-set sizes. Granular-pair counts are 56,283, 36,812, and 38,618 for GSM8K and 31,248, 33,960, and 39,496 for MATH across Mistral, Llemma, and DeepSeek. Tables 6–7 show selective question coverage: in MATH, only 48.19%–62.92% of source questions have at least four granular instances; in GSM8K, the corresponding range is 57.00%–61.95%. These statistics show that the paired corpus is shaped by which problems yield both correct and incorrect self-generations.

The paper also records evidence against a simple “better reward means better data” story. Preference-trained models produce less diverse sampled answers than SFT/RFT models, and Appendix E shows the chosen-over-rejected win rate quickly converging to one. The authors connect this to overconfidence or reward exploitation. Their GPT-4 FLASK evaluation of 100 random GSM8K test questions gives Self-Explore the highest reported robustness, correctness, and efficiency scores, but it is a model-judged sample, not an independent corpus audit.

The official repository at commit 54b8ba9f4cee1ef52f72de916e100e0da2ae6863 substantiates that the pipeline is executable: it contains raw-generation, answer-checking, RFT/pair construction, exploration, gpair formation, DPO, and evaluation code plus source task JSONL files. It does not contain any paper-run generated intermediate or final pair files and has no GitHub release or repository license. Two author Hugging Face checkpoints exist, but the README's task labels and links are inconsistent, so the checkpoint mapping is not a clean reproduction manifest.

ACL 正式论文在三个 7B 模型家族上比较 SFT、RFT、结果监督 DPO 与 Self-Explore，并同时评测 GSM8K 和 MATH。论文报告相对 SFT 的平均提升为 GSM8K 11.57%、MATH 2.89%，三个模型家族均有提升。这些是作者训练与检查点选择协议下的下游准确率，支持生成监督的用途，但不能验证每一个 first-pit 标签。

DeepSeek-Math 消融实验隔离了偏好跨度设计。表 1 中，完整成对数据在 GSM8K/MATH 上为 74.83/34.92，细粒度成对数据为 78.47/37.68。只使用 chosen 的第一步，或把 pit 及其后所有步骤一起拒绝，结果都介于两者之间，支持“保留完整恢复续写、只拒绝 pit”这一具体设计。另一项实验把探索宽度从四次增加到 32 次，却没有取得更高性能，说明操作标签的训练价值不会随搜索预算单调增加。

附录表 5 给出实际训练集规模。Mistral、Llemma、DeepSeek 在 GSM8K 上的细粒度偏好对分别为 56,283、36,812、38,618，在 MATH 上为 31,248、33,960、39,496。表 6–7 还显示问题覆盖具有选择性：MATH 中只有 48.19%–62.92% 的来源问题至少产生四条细粒度样本，GSM8K 对应范围为 57.00%–61.95%。这些统计表明，成对语料由哪些问题能同时生成正确与错误解答所塑造。

论文也给出了反对“奖励更好就等于数据更好”这一简单叙事的证据。经过偏好训练的模型，其采样答案多样性低于 SFT/RFT；附录 E 中 chosen 对 rejected 的胜率也很快趋近于 1。作者将其与过度自信或奖励利用联系起来。对 100 个随机 GSM8K 测试问题进行 GPT-4 FLASK 评测时，Self-Explore 的稳健性、正确性与效率得分最高，但这只是模型裁判的小样本评估，并非独立语料审计。

官方仓库提交 54b8ba9f4cee1ef52f72de916e100e0da2ae6863 证明流水线可执行：它包含原始生成、答案检查、RFT/配对、探索、gpair 构造、DPO 与评测代码，以及来源任务 JSONL。然而，仓库没有任何论文运行产生的中间或最终偏好文件，也没有 GitHub release 或仓库许可。作者名下存在两个 Hugging Face 检查点，但 README 的任务标签与链接不一致，因此检查点映射不能视为完整复现清单。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Self-Explore's central move is to reinterpret a rejected rationale as a collection of search states. Instead of assigning one negative label to the whole sequence, it asks from which prefix the current model ceases to recover the answer and moves the preceding context into the preference prompt. This makes rejected data productive without requesting dense human judgments.

The resulting supervision is finer than outcome preference but cheaper than an independently labeled process-reward corpus. One target-model family plays generator, explorer, reference policy, and final policy roles at different stages. Programmatic final-answer checks provide the only external signal. The construction therefore shows how an answer verifier plus step-conditioned sampling can synthesize process-shaped pairwise data.

The paper is also valuable for separating three meanings often conflated under “first error.” A semantic first error is the earliest mathematically invalid step; a process-reward label is an externally assigned judgment of a step; Self-Explore's first pit is the earliest prefix with empirical recovery rate zero in four trials. Only the third is produced. Naming that distinction prevents a useful model-relative label from being overstated as ground truth.

The method does not introduce a learned verifier or release a new static dataset. Its novelty lies in recycling failures, localizing the negative span, and showing through ablations that the chosen/rejected span geometry matters. The absent generated artifacts remain an important gap between an open recipe and an auditable open data release.

Self-Explore 的核心做法是把一条被拒推理重新解释成一组搜索状态。它不再给整条序列分配一个负标签，而是询问：从哪个前缀开始，当前模型不再能够恢复到正确答案；随后把此前上下文移入偏好 prompt。这样，无需密集人工判断，也能让失败数据产生训练价值。

所得监督比结果级偏好更细，又比独立人工标注的过程奖励语料更便宜。同一目标模型家族在不同阶段依次承担生成器、探索器、参考策略和最终策略角色，唯一外部信号来自程序化最终答案检查。因此，这套构造展示了如何用答案验证器加步骤条件采样合成具有过程形状的成对数据。

论文还区分了经常被“首错”一词混在一起的三种含义：语义首错是最早的数学无效步骤；过程奖励标签是外部对某一步的判断；Self-Explore 的 first pit 则是四次试验中经验恢复率首次为零的最早前缀。方法实际只生成第三种。明确这一点，可以避免把有用的模型相对标签夸大成客观金标。

该方法没有引入学习式验证器，也没有发布新的静态生成数据集。其新意在于回收失败、缩小负例跨度，并通过消融说明 chosen/rejected 的跨度几何会影响训练。生成产物缺失，仍是“开放配方”与“可审计开放数据发布”之间的重要差距。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The first-pit label is a finite-search estimate. Four failures at temperature 0.7 mean that this RFT checkpoint did not sample a correct recovery within that budget. A low-probability recovery may exist, a stronger explorer may succeed, or a different segmentation may move the boundary. The width ablation itself shows that labels and downstream effects change with search size, so “first wrong step” is an interpretive shorthand rather than a proved property.

Outcome verification is imperfect. A rationale can reach the correct numeric answer through cancellation, guessing, or invalid reasoning. The GSM8K code mitigates this for retained positives by checking embedded equations, but free-text logic is still unchecked; MATH depends on answer extraction and symbolic/format equivalence code. Valid alternative formats can be rejected, while parser artifacts can be accepted. The paper explicitly notes that its correct-answer assumption is weaker for small answer spaces such as true/false or multiple choice.

Pair coverage is endogenous to model skill. Easy GSM8K questions often produce too few incorrect candidates; hard MATH questions often produce too few correct ones. A problem needs both sides to form an outcome pair and recoveries to form a granular pair, so the final distribution over source questions differs from the original training distribution. Maximum-edit-distance heuristics further favor particular negative styles, and removing conclusions changes the object optimized by DPO.

Self-generated preference learning can narrow the policy. The paper reports improved top-1 accuracy alongside reduced answer diversity, weaker majority-vote behavior than SFT/RFT in some analyses, and reward win rates that rapidly reach one. These signals are consistent with overconfidence, memorization of limited training questions, or reward exploitation. Experiments are limited to two math datasets and 7B base models; continual rounds, larger models, broader domains, and strongly instruction-tuned reasoners are untested.

The release is incomplete for data audit. The source task files and code exist, but raw 100-way candidates, per-row deduplication results, correct/incorrect labels, outcome pairs, step prompts, four continuations, extracted answers, first-pit decisions, discarded examples, and final gpair files do not. There is no immutable release manifest, and the code-paper difference in chosen selection means regenerating with current code need not reproduce the reported corpus.

Rights and contamination are unresolved. The paper states licenses for datasets and model assets, and the author checkpoints advertise Apache-2.0, but the GitHub repository has no detected license and generated-data terms are unstated. No explicit decontamination audit covers train/test overlap, paraphrases, generated rationales, or base-model pretraining exposure. The README also swaps or misspells checkpoint links, leaving task-to-checkpoint identity ambiguous without independent inspection.

first-pit 标签只是有限搜索估计。温度 0.7 下四次失败，意味着当前 RFT 检查点在该预算内没有采样到正确恢复；低概率恢复可能仍然存在，更强探索器可能成功，不同步骤切分也可能移动边界。探索宽度消融本身就表明，标签与下游效果会随搜索规模变化，因此“第一个错误步骤”只是解释性简称，而不是被证明的属性。

结果验证并不完美。推理可能通过错误抵消、猜测或无效过程得到正确数值。GSM8K 代码通过检查嵌入算式来缓解保留正例的问题，但自由文本逻辑仍未验证；MATH 则依赖答案抽取和符号/格式等价代码。有效的等价格式可能被拒绝，解析器伪影也可能被接受。论文明确指出，其“答案正确意味着过程可信”的假设在真假题或选择题等小答案空间中更弱。

偏好对覆盖由模型能力内生决定。简单 GSM8K 问题常产生过少错误候选，困难 MATH 问题常产生过少正确候选。问题必须同时有正负两侧才能形成结果偏好对，还要有成功恢复才能形成细粒度偏好对，因此最终问题分布不同于原训练集。最大编辑距离启发式还会偏向特定负例风格，而删除结论也改变了 DPO 实际优化的对象。

自生成偏好学习可能收窄策略。论文在 top-1 准确率提高的同时，报告了答案多样性降低、部分分析中的多数投票能力弱于 SFT/RFT，以及奖励胜率迅速趋近 1。这些信号与过度自信、记忆有限训练问题或奖励利用一致。实验只覆盖两个数学数据集和 7B 基础模型；持续多轮训练、更大模型、更广领域和强指令微调推理模型均未测试。

发布物不足以进行数据审计。来源任务文件和代码存在，但 100 路原始候选、逐条去重结果、正误标签、结果偏好对、步骤 prompt、四次续写、抽取答案、first-pit 决定、丢弃样本和最终 gpair 文件都未发布。没有不可变发行清单，而且 chosen 选择上的论文—代码差异意味着当前代码重建的语料未必等同于论文运行语料。

权利与污染也未解决。论文说明了数据集和模型资产许可，作者检查点标注 Apache-2.0，但 GitHub 仓库没有检测到许可文件，生成数据条款也未声明。没有明确去污染审计覆盖训练/测试重叠、改写问题、生成推理或基础模型预训练暴露。README 还交换或拼错了检查点链接，若不独立检查，任务与检查点身份仍有歧义。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data_construction_open_release_recipes track, Self-Explore is a compact template for recovering value from rejected reasoning traces. It provides a concrete comparison between whole-trajectory outcome preferences and step-local negatives, and it makes the recovery budget part of the annotation contract. Researchers can adapt the recipe anywhere a candidate completion has a cheap terminal checker and can be segmented into meaningful states.

The method is useful for studies of process-supervision noise. By varying explorer checkpoint, sampling temperature, number of continuations, step segmentation, answer parser, or chosen-span selection, one can measure label stability and identify prefixes whose recoverability is uncertain. Comparing first pits with human or symbolic first-error judgments would separate “hard for this model to recover” from “mathematically invalid.”

It also supplies a baseline for preference-data geometry. The paper's ablations compare full correct/incorrect trajectories, full recovery versus one chosen step, and pit-only versus pit-plus-suffix rejection. A derivative release could use the same source candidates to construct several pair views, enabling controlled tests without regenerating the expensive 100-way corpus.

Actual reuse requires regeneration because the paper-run data are absent. A responsible implementation should pin source problem IDs, code commit, SFT and RFT checkpoint revisions, all decoding parameters, random seeds, tokenizer, step splitter, answer checker, and pair cap. It should save raw candidates, every exploration continuation and extracted answer, retained/rejected decisions, and final pairs with stable IDs. Generated-data licensing and train/test semantic-overlap checks should be completed before redistribution.

The released checkpoints may help reproduce endpoints, but their mapping is not clean: the repository README associates the GSM8K row with a repository named DeepSeek_MATH_Self_Explore and links the MATH row to a misspelled GSM8K URL, while both correctly spelled author repositories exist. Reusers should identify task provenance from model contents or author clarification rather than trusting the table links.

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 赛道而言，Self-Explore 是从失败推理轨迹中回收价值的紧凑模板。它给出了完整轨迹结果偏好与步骤局部负例的具体对比，并把恢复搜索预算写进标注契约。只要候选响应具有低成本终局检查器，并能切分成有意义的状态，这套配方就可以迁移。

该方法适合研究过程监督噪声。通过改变探索器检查点、采样温度、续写次数、步骤切分、答案解析器或 chosen 跨度选择，可以测量标签稳定性，识别恢复性不确定的前缀。把 first pit 与人工或符号式首错判断对比，还能区分“当前模型难以恢复”和“数学上无效”。

它也提供了偏好数据几何的基线。论文消融比较完整正确/错误轨迹、完整恢复与单个 chosen 步骤，以及只拒绝 pit 与拒绝 pit 加后缀。衍生发布可以从同一批来源候选构造多种偏好视图，在不重新生成昂贵 100 路语料的情况下做受控实验。

由于论文运行数据缺失，实际复用必须重新生成。负责任的实现应固定来源问题 ID、代码提交、SFT/RFT 检查点修订、全部解码参数、随机种子、tokenizer、步骤切分器、答案检查器和配对上限；保存原始候选、每次探索续写及抽取答案、保留/拒绝决定和带稳定 ID 的最终偏好对。重新分发前还应明确生成数据许可，并完成训练/测试语义重叠检查。

公开检查点可帮助复现终点，但映射并不清晰：仓库 README 把 GSM8K 行链接到名为 DeepSeek_MATH_Self_Explore 的仓库，又把 MATH 行链接到拼错的 GSM8K 地址，而作者名下两个正确拼写的仓库都存在。使用者应通过模型内容或作者确认任务来源，不能直接信任表格链接。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• “First pit” means the earliest tested step with zero correct recoveries among four samples from the RFT explorer; it is not a proof of the first mathematical error.
  • The pipeline samples 100 full rationales per problem, keeps programmatically verified positives for RFT, forms outcome pairs, then explores rejected prefixes. GSM8K additionally checks embedded arithmetic equations for retained positives.
  • A granular row has only prompt/chosen/rejected: the prompt contains the accepted prefix, chosen is a recovery completion, and rejected is the localized pit step. The intermediate evidence needed to audit that transformation is not released.
  • Paper and code differ on chosen selection: the paper says random correct recovery, while current code chooses the shortest eligible unused recovery. The eight-pair cap also has a reported Mistral/GSM8K exception.
  • Downstream gains coexist with selective problem coverage, reduced sampled-answer diversity, and rapidly saturated preference rewards. Benchmark performance is not a first-pit accuracy audit.
  • The repository releases source task files and construction code, not the paper-run generated corpora; repository licensing, generated-data terms, decontamination, and clean checkpoint mapping remain unresolved.

• first pit 指 RFT 探索器四次采样均无法正确恢复的最早测试步骤，不是第一个数学错误的证明。
  • 流水线每题采样 100 条完整推理，保留程序验证正确的正例做 RFT，再形成结果偏好对并探索拒绝前缀；GSM8K 对保留正例还会检查嵌入算式。
  • 细粒度行最终只有 prompt/chosen/rejected：prompt 含已接受前缀，chosen 是恢复续写，rejected 是定位出的 pit 步骤。审计这一转换所需的中间证据并未发布。
  • 论文与代码的 chosen 选择不同：论文称随机选择正确恢复，当前代码选择最短的合格未用恢复；每题八对上限也存在 Mistral/GSM8K 例外。
  • 下游增益同时伴随来源问题覆盖选择性、采样答案多样性降低和偏好奖励快速饱和。基准性能不是 first-pit 准确性审计。
  • 仓库发布来源任务文件和构造代码，不发布论文运行生成语料；仓库许可、生成数据条款、去污染和清晰检查点映射仍未解决。
